nodes.text:
Why #HMPV is Less Lethal than #COVID-19
1️⃣ Slower Evolution:It mutates less, so vaccines can be developed faster if needed.

2️⃣ Larger Size:Being bigger than COVID-19, it’s easier to study under a microscope.

3️⃣ Simplicity:Smaller genome reduces the chances of harmful mutations.
